name: 39-ajaju
description: Ajaju: a green chameleon-like creature on very long thin straight pale-yellow bamboo-stalk legs, bulging eyes, small orange crest, curled tail, red forked tongues hanging from its mouth. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Standing still on its long legs, facing the same direction: its red forked tongues fan out wide from its mouth, widest at frame 3, draw back in, then flick out again at frame 7, while the curled tail slowly curls and uncurls. Body, head and legs stay in place. Same size, black one-pixel outlines, flat fills. No effects.
